text: [excited] A giant tower just caught a spaceship... with chopsticks!
Friday evening, SpaceX's Starship blasted off from Texas. Forty-one stories of rocket.
[curious] The top half kept going. Fourteen laps around the Earth, in twenty-two hours.
Then it came home. Flipped upright. Lit three engines... [excited] and the tower's arms snapped shut. Caught! A first, ever.
[deadpan] The booster? The part they'd caught before? Low on fuel... it blew up over the sea.
[playfully] Would you stand under those chopsticks? Send this to a friend who drops everything.
